title: Die Pilzthiere oder Schleimpilze, nach dem neuesten Standpunkte bearbeitet
author: Wilhelm Zopf (1846-1909)
notes: The monograph of the slime moulds that stands between Rostafinski's Polish monograph of 1875 and Lister's English one of 1894 (Breslau, Trewendt, 1885). Written while the question de Bary opened was still live, it treats the group as Pilzthiere, fungus animals, and works through their structure, development and classification at book length. German prose throughout, with no English edition. First-translation candidate. Collection: slime-moulds, mycology. Source: archive.org, University of Toronto copy, 194 images.

title: A Monograph of the Mycetozoa, being a descriptive catalogue of the species in the herbarium of the British Museum
author: Arthur Lister (1830-1908); plates by Gulielma Lister
notes: The work that made the slime moulds legible to English readers (London, British Museum, 1894). Lister reorganised Rostafinski's classification and illustrated it with plates drawn by his daughter Gulielma, who carried the work through two later editions of her own. For most of the twentieth century this, rather than Rostafinski, is how the field knew the group. Already in English, so it is here for the plates and the comparison rather than for translation. Collection: slime-moulds, mycology. Source: archive.org, MBLWHOI Library copy, 410 images.
